name: worktrunk-markers
description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows. This plugin shows each Codex session's activity (🤖 working, 💬 waiting) in wt list.

hooks.command: bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/wt.sh" config state marker set 🤖 || true
hooks.commandWindows: cmd /d /c call "${PLUGIN_ROOT}\hooks\wt.cmd" config state marker set 🤖

hooks.command: bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/wt.sh" config state marker set 💬 || true
hooks.commandWindows: cmd /d /c call "${PLUGIN_ROOT}\hooks\wt.cmd" config state marker set 💬

hooks.command: bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/wt.sh" config state marker set 💬 || true
hooks.commandWindows: cmd /d /c call "${PLUGIN_ROOT}\hooks\wt.cmd" config state marker set 💬

hooks.command: bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/wt.sh" config state marker clear || true
hooks.commandWindows: cmd /d /c call "${PLUGIN_ROOT}\hooks\wt.cmd" config state marker clear

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex session activity in wt list.
interface.longDescription: Marks the worktree a Codex session runs in as working or waiting, so wt list shows which sessions need attention.
